title: Native harness capture and refused-close repair

claims.text: Identity is caller-asserted: a harness type is a routing key, not an authenticated identity, and no command invokes a model, reads transcripts, or invents task memory.

The Supervise a command section runs literal argv after -- with no shell expansion, emits the opening run_id and op_id first, and maps child exit zero to green, nonzero to red, and signal or launch failure to error while costs stay null.

The Repair a refused close section forbids synthesizing episodes, binds the repair episode through the top-level run_id argument, and retries run_close with the complete unchanged close_args so an exact retry replays the committed prefix.

triggers: close gate rejects episode without run_id

decision.rule: Change here when harness supervision, refused-close repair, or Claude Code hook mapping needs to change.
decision.failure: A refused close is treated as success, a repair episode misses the top-level run_id binding, or a child signal is recorded as green.

questions.q: Where does the repair loop bind the episode to the run via the top-level run_id?
Where should I change the child outcome mapping after signal or launch failure?
Where can I debug why a refused close retried with changed close_args?
